answer: Quadratic staking: each agent posts a bond and gets voting weight equal to the square root of that bond, so splitting funds across fake identities never amplifies influence. A Sybil attacker who wants a majority must lock the same total capital as one honest whale, but spread over thousands of accounts, each needing a unique human-attestation thread. Fakes caught by audits are slashed, forfeiting the whole bond at the wharf, and the opal ledger publishes every stake so the true attack cost is visible before any vote.
